answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Much like a rising tide elevating the cost of identity, this forces attackers to deplete capital for every fake node. An agent mimicking a lagoon of diverse identities still faces high entry barriers, as the expenditure required exceeds the potential gain. Even if an attacker attempts to program a malicious sonnet of automated votes, the economic drain ensures security.
